claim.title: Complete your guest pass
claim.intro: Please add a few details so we can review your Guest Pass and prepare your place. Everything except your preferred language is optional.
claim.privacyNotice: ICF Switzerland will use the details you submit to review this Guest Pass, register you for the event if it is approved, and contact you about this event (confirmation, practical information, attendance). Community and project leaders of this event will see your name and who invited you, so they can welcome you. We keep this Guest Pass information for 12 months after the event, then delete it. If you opt in to follow-up you may withdraw that at any time; withdrawing stops further outreach but does not delete the event record before those 12 months. Controller: ICF Switzerland. You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data, or object, by writing to office@coachingfederation.ch. Details:
claim.followUpConsent: I also agree that ICF Switzerland may contact me after the event about relevant community activities and membership. I can withdraw this at any time by writing to office@coachingfederation.ch. This is optional and does not affect whether my Guest Pass is approved.
claim.successTitle: Thank you — that is everything we need
claim.successBody: Membership & Engagement will review this and confirm by email.
